messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — Orion Payments POC stuck provisioning Dedicated GPU pool in eu-west3. They hit an error when we try to allocate reserved capacity with AZ affinity. Error from provisioner: "allocation_failed: region_affinity_mismatch (code: PROV-409)". Customer is blocked for their end-of-week demo.

maria_cs: Ugh. Do we know if this is quota-related or an internal mapping issue with reserved AZs? Customer account: orion-payments-prod-231.

sam_infra: Looking at the infra logs now. I see the APICall to cloud provider returned 409 with body: '{"error":"RequestedAvailabilityZone not available for reservation","region":"eu-west3","attempts":3}'. Also a subsequent fallback tried eu-west2 and failed LB binding.

leo_se: @sam_infra can we temporarily drop AZ affinity so they can at least validate latency/throughput? We'll need a note for pricing change if they accept non-affine pool.

sam_infra: We can, but note that dropping affinity changes network egress for private deployments and may require re-issuing their IP allowlist. Also needs re-approval for security questionnaire item 4.2.

chen_eng: From runtime side the allocator expects reservation config key `az_affinity: strict|preferred|none`. Current template set to `strict`. If we flip to `preferred`, provisioner should try eu-west3 primary but allow other AZs in that region. Sample snippet: ```json
{
  "reservation_id": "resv-231-orion",
  "gpu_count": 8,
  "region": "eu-west3",
  "az_affinity": "preferred",
  "start_time": "2026-04-01T08:00:00Z"
}```

alex_sales: Customer asked about cost if we switch to preferred (possible cross-AZ). They want a quick delta estimate for the demo. Leo, can you give seat-of-pants vs formal quote?

leo_se: Seat-of-pants: preferred affinity may increase networking premium ~5-8% and risk minor latency variance. For committed pricing we prorate by day. I'll ping finance for exact per-day delta; meanwhile we can offer a one-week waiver for the demo.

maria_cs: They also submitted the security questionnaire and flagged private networking + KMS keys. If we change AZs we should confirm KMS key region compatibility. Sam, can you confirm?

sam_infra: KMS keys are region-scoped. If we cross AZ within same region, key is fine. If we fallback to eu-west2 that's a different region — that'll require a new CMK or key replication. Right now the failure shows the provider didn't honor eu-west3 AZ reservation because of capacity fragmentation, not our KMS config.

provision-bot: [provisioner] Reservation resv-231-orion status -> FAILED (allocation_failed: region_affinity_mismatch) at 2026-03-20T14:12:07Z

chen_eng: Proposed path: 1) switch reservation `az_affinity` to `preferred` and re-run; 2) if still fails, fallback to eu-west2 with explicit KMS replication step and update allowlist. I can make a one-click template to try preferred.

alex_sales: Customer urgent ask — can we get them a green endpoint for the demo by tomorrow morning? If so they'll proceed with a short-term PO.

leo_se: If we run `preferred` and it succeeds, yes. I'll send them a temporary addendum for the demo covering potential cross-AZ networking.

sam_infra: I've queued a re-provision with `az_affinity: preferred` now (job 54921). Will post logs.

provision-bot: [provisioner] Job 54921 started for resv-231-orion at 2026-03-20T14:35:12Z

provision-bot: [provisioner] Job 54921 event: allocated 2/8 nodes in eu-west3, remaining nodes allocated in eu-west2 (cross-region fallback) -> PARTIAL_ALLOC at 2026-03-20T14:42:03Z

sam_infra: Partial alloc detected. We're seeing mixed AZs across eu-west3 and eu-west2. KMS note — need new CMK in eu-west2 before enabling secrets there. I can create a temporary KMS for demo if CS approves.

maria_cs: Customer approved temporary KMS creation for demo only. They acknowledged encryption boundary.

provision-bot: [provisioner] Job 54921 status -> POOL_READY (status: mixed_az, note: demo-ready) at 2026-03-20T15:05:49Z

alex_sales: Awesome — customer demo greenlit for tomorrow. Leo please follow up on pricing waiver and update the PO. Chen/Sam/Maria thanks for the fast swarming.

leo_se: On it, will send demo addendum and price delta. Follow-up ticket for full compliance/production: TICKET-4829.

chen_eng: I'll add a telemetry flag to mark this pool as mixed_az so Optimize can exclude it from production perf baselines.

sam_infra: I'll run a post-mortem on capacity fragmentation in eu-west3 and feed into our capacity planning.

maria_cs: Closing loop with customer now. :tada:
